items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: I used to try to imitate Louie. I had him pretty close.

ctx.x: He didn't play, he just talked, told about the old times here.
Well I love Louie because I remember a long time ago when Louie played a lot of records out of the youngster and I used to try to imitate Louie. I had him pretty close. On what?
On singing. On singing. I used to imitate him quite a lot on singing. I didn't know if you were trying to play trumpet the most of the day.
